name: Hakase Chino
source:
A maid robot, an artificial individuality created by Dr. Hakase. Normally, she appears like an ordinary girl, but she can transform into various machines and electrical appliances at will. 

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%98%9F%E3%81%AE%E7%8E%8B%E5%AD%90%E3%81%8F%E3%82%93]Wikipedia[/url]]
